title: Accidents Involving Heavy Vehicles Driven by S Pass and Work Permit Holders
what_it_is: Accidents Involving Heavy Vehicles Driven by S Pass and Work Permit Holders

sections.label: Heavy vehicle accident statistics
sections.summary: Over five years, heavy vehicles averaged 791 injuries and 39 fatal accidents yearly, with about 45% of at-fault drivers being foreigners.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the last five years, there were, on average, each year 791 injuries and 39 fatal accidents involving heavy vehicles, including buses and goods vehicles.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For accidents in which the heavy vehicle drivers were found to be at fault, around 45% of the drivers were foreigners, including work permit and S Pass holders.

sections.label: Average speed cameras, tachograph trial
sections.summary: Next year TP will deploy Average Speed Cameras in enforcement zones and will conduct a tachograph trial on heavy vehicles this year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Next year, TP will be deploying Average Speed Cameras to detect and compute the average speed of a vehicle as it enters and exits the enforcement zones.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: TP will also conduct a tachograph trial on heavy vehicles this year.

sections.label: Foreign vocational driver licence rule
sections.summary: From 1 January 2016, foreign vocational drivers must obtain a Singapore driving licence within six months of Work Pass issuance, down from one year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: On the first point, starting from 1 January 2016, foreign vocational drivers are required to obtain a Singapore driving licence within six months of the issuance of their Work Pass as compared to one year previously.

sections.label: Speed limiters introduced 1999
sections.summary: Speed limiters were introduced in Singapore in July 1999 to reduce speed-related accidents caused by heavy vehicles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: On the second question, speed limiters were introduced in Singapore in July 1999 to reduce the number of speed-related accidents caused by heavy vehicles.

sections.label: Speed limiter tampering penalties
sections.summary: TP conducts operations against speed limiter tampering and faulty limiters; offenders can be jailed up to three months or fined up to $1,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: TP has been stepping up enforcement efforts by conducting operations to detect and deter the tampering of speed limiters in heavy vehicles and driving with a faulty speed limiter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Any person who tampers with speed limiters of heavy vehicles or who drives a heavy vehicle with a faulty speed limiter can be jailed up to three months or fined up to $1,000.
